**הסבר קצר:** המבנה **Only after a conflagration has swept through** אומר שהאצטרובלים נפתחים רק אחרי השריפה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על הסדר הזה במילה **until** (עד ש).

_**Only after** the fire do the cones open, and the correct answer keeps this order with **until** a fire has swept through the forest._

questionText: Original: The mural, which the city had commissioned from a young painter and which critics initially dismissed as lurid, was restored decades later by conservators she herself had trained.

options.label: Decades after the city gave a young painter the commission for the mural, conservators who had once trained her restored it, although critics initially dismissed it as lurid.
The young painter from whom the city commissioned the mural, which critics at first dismissed as lurid, had personally trained the conservators who restored it decades later.
The mural that the city commissioned from a young painter was not dismissed as lurid by critics until decades later, when conservators she herself had trained restored it.
The city commissioned a young painter to restore the mural that critics had dismissed as lurid, and decades later she trained conservators to do the same.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **conservators she herself had trained** אומר שהציירת היא שהכשירה את אנשי השימור, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך בצירוף **had personally trained the conservators** (הכשירה בעצמה את אנשי השימור).

_**conservators she herself had trained** means the painter trained the restorers, and the correct answer keeps this: she **had personally trained the conservators**._

questionText: Original: Not only did the tax on sugary drinks raise more revenue than forecast, but it also prompted several manufacturers, long loath to alter their recipes, to cut the sugar in their best-selling brands.

options.label: Several manufacturers that had long resisted changing their recipes cut the sugar in their top-selling brands in response to the tax on sugary drinks, which also brought in more money than expected.
Not only did the tax on sugary drinks bring in a great deal of money, but it also persuaded several manufacturers to cut the sugar in their most popular brands.

The tax on sugary drinks brought in more revenue than had been forecast, and most manufacturers, who had long been loath to alter their recipes, responded by cutting the sugar in their best-selling brands.
Several manufacturers, long loath to pay a tax on sugary drinks, cut the sugar in their best-selling brands so that the tax would raise less revenue than forecast.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המבנה **Not only did ... but it also** מחבר שתי תוצאות של המס, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שתיהן, כולל הצירוף **more money than expected** (יותר מהצפוי) והמילה **Several** (כמה).

_**Not only ... but also** joins two results of the tax, and the correct answer keeps both, including **more money than expected** and **Several** manufacturers._

questionText: Original: What turns flamingos pink is less their genes than the pigments in the algae and shrimp they eat, which is why captive birds deprived of such food gradually fade to a pallid white.

options.label: Flamingos' genes, rather than the pigments in the algae and shrimp they eat, are what mainly turn them pink, which is why captive birds keep their color even on a plain diet.
Flamingos owe their pink color more to pigments in the algae and shrimp in their diet than to their genes, so in captivity, without that food, they slowly turn a pale white.
Captive flamingos fade to a pallid white when zoos lack the funds to feed them the algae and shrimp whose pigments, rather than the birds' genes, are mainly what turns them pink.
Because captive flamingos lack the genes for pink pigment, they turn pale even when fed the algae and shrimp that their wild relatives eat.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המבנה **less their genes than the pigments** פירושו שהצבע תלוי יותר בפיגמנטים שבמזון מאשר בגנים, והתשובה הנכונה אומרת זאת בצירוף **more to pigments ... than to their genes** (יותר לפיגמנטים מאשר לגנים).

_**less their genes than the pigments** means diet matters more than genes, which the correct answer keeps with **more to pigments ... than to their genes**._

questionText: Original: Little did the engineers who added a text-messaging function to early mobile phones suspect that a feature they regarded as a trifling extra would one day rival voice calls in popularity.

options.label: Although they considered texting a trifling extra, the engineers who installed it on early mobile phones had little doubt that one day it would rival voice calls in popularity.

Early mobile phones were given a texting function mainly to please the network operators, and the engineers who designed it, viewing the feature as an unimportant bonus, little suspected that the feature would one day be used as widely as voice calls.
Little did early mobile-phone users suspect that the engineers regarded text messaging as a trifling extra, since it soon rivaled voice calls in popularity.
The engineers who built texting into early mobile phones saw it as a minor add-on and had no idea that it would eventually become about as popular as voice calls.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המבנה **Little did ... suspect** פירושו שהמהנדסים כלל לא חשדו, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על השלילה בצירוף **had no idea** (לא היה להם מושג).

_**Little did ... suspect** means the engineers did not suspect at all, which the correct answer keeps with **had no idea**._

questionText: Original: Much as most internet users avow that their privacy matters to them, few are willing to pay even a small fee for a service that would keep their personal data out of advertisers' hands.

options.label: Few internet users are willing to pay even a small fee for a service that would keep their personal data out of advertisers' hands, because most of them avow that their privacy matters to them.
Much as most internet users claim to value their privacy, few will pay even a little to keep their personal data from advertisers, since they doubt that such services work.
Although the majority of internet users say they care about their privacy, only a handful would pay even a modest fee for a service that kept advertisers from getting their personal data.
Much as advertisers avow that they respect internet users' privacy, few of them are willing to pay even a small fee for the personal data they collect.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **Much as** פירושו ״אף על פי ש״, לא ״כמו״ ולא ״מפני ש״, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על יחס הניגוד במילה **Although** (למרות ש).

_**Much as** means although, not because, and the correct answer keeps this contrast with **Although** the majority say they care._

questionText: Original: Nowhere is the city's housing shortage more palpable than in its university district, where rents have nearly doubled in a decade and some students now commute from neighboring towns.

options.label: The university district is where the city's housing shortage is most keenly felt: rents there have almost doubled in ten years, and some students now travel in from nearby towns.
Nowhere is the city's housing shortage more palpable than in its university district, where rents have more than tripled in a decade and some students now commute from neighboring towns.
The housing shortage weighs more heavily on the university district than on other parts of the city; rents there have nearly doubled in a decade, and most students now come in from surrounding towns.

The university district has done more than the rest of the city to ease the housing shortage, even though some students now commute from neighboring towns and its rents have nearly doubled over the past ten years.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המבנה **Nowhere is ... more palpable than** פירושו ״מורגש ביותר״, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת עליו ועל הפרטים **almost doubled** (כמעט הוכפלו) ו־**some students** (חלק מהסטודנטים).

_**Nowhere is ... more palpable than** means most keenly felt, and the correct answer keeps it along with **almost doubled** and **some students**._

questionText: Original: However ostentatious the canal-side homes of the city's merchants appeared from the street, their interiors were often furnished so plainly that visitors from abroad remarked on the contrast.

options.label: However ostentatious the canal-side homes of the city's merchants appeared from the street, their interiors were rarely furnished so plainly that visitors from abroad remarked on the contrast.
Long before the city's merchants gave their canal-side homes such showy street fronts, foreign guests had commented on how simply the interiors were furnished.
The city's merchants often furnished their canal-side homes so simply that foreign visitors commented on the contrast with the exteriors, however showy those looked from the street.
Visitors from abroad, however ostentatious their own homes, often remarked that the merchants furnished their canal-side houses too plainly to impress passers-by from the street.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **often furnished so plainly** אומר שהריהוט הפשוט היה נפוץ למרות החזית הראוותנית (**However ostentatious**), והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם במילה **often** ובצירוף **however showy**.

_**However ostentatious** the fronts, the interiors were **often furnished so plainly** that visitors noticed, and the correct answer keeps both with **often** and **however showy**._

questionText: Original: Most of the quotations in one celebrated nineteenth-century dictionary were gathered by zealous unpaid volunteers, whose handwritten slips were then sorted and checked by a small team of salaried editors.

options.label: Zealous unpaid volunteers, hoping to see their names in print, gathered most of the quotations in one celebrated nineteenth-century dictionary, and a small team of salaried editors then sorted and checked their slips.

Enthusiastic unpaid volunteers collected a few of the quotations in one celebrated nineteenth-century dictionary; their handwritten slips were later sorted and checked by a small team of editors on the payroll.
Most of the quotations gathered by a small team of salaried editors were sorted and checked by zealous unpaid volunteers before appearing in one celebrated nineteenth-century dictionary.
A small team of paid editors sorted and checked the handwritten slips on which eager unpaid volunteers had collected most of the quotations for one celebrated nineteenth-century dictionary.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** לפי הצירוף **gathered by zealous unpaid volunteers** המתנדבים אספו את רוב הציטוטים והעורכים רק מיינו ובדקו, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על החלוקה הזו ועל הכמות (**most**, רוב).

_The volunteers **gathered** most quotations and the editors **sorted and checked** them, and the correct answer keeps these roles and **most**._

questionText: Original: No fewer than four in five of the undergraduates surveyed claimed to have read the assigned novel, yet barely a third of them could give a cogent summary of its plot.

options.label: No fewer than four in five of the undergraduates surveyed claimed to have read the assigned novel, and most of those students could give a cogent summary of its plot.
At least eighty percent of the undergraduates surveyed said that they had read the assigned novel, but only about a third were able to summarize its plot coherently.
At least four in five of the undergraduates surveyed had actually read the assigned novel, though barely a third of them could sum up its plot clearly.
Barely a third of the undergraduates surveyed claimed to have read the assigned novel, yet more than three-quarters of them could give a cogent summary of its plot.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **claimed to have read** (טענו שקראו) והצירוף **barely a third** (בקושי שליש) נשמרים בתשובה הנכונה בצירופים **said that they had read** ו־**only about a third**.

_The correct answer keeps **claimed to have read** as **said that they had read** and **barely a third** as **only about a third**._

questionText: Original: So raucous were the weekend parties in the apartment upstairs that the couple below, having put up with them for over a year, moved out two months before their lease ran out.

options.label: The couple downstairs put up with the rowdy weekend parties above them for over a year, but the noise drove them out two months before their lease ended.
So raucous were the weekend parties in the apartment upstairs that the couple below moved out within two months, more than a year before their lease ran out.
The weekend parties in the apartment above were so noisy that the couple living downstairs, who had put up with them for over a year, eventually decided to move out.
So raucous were the couple below that the neighbors upstairs, having put up with them for over a year, stopped holding weekend parties two months before their lease ran out.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המבנה **So raucous were the weekend parties ... that** אומר שהרעש הוא שגרם לזוג לעזוב, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך ועל שני הזמנים: **for over a year** ו־**two months before their lease ended**.

_**So raucous ... that** makes the noise the cause, and the correct answer keeps both time details: **for over a year** and **two months before their lease ended**._

questionText: Original: But for the chlorination of drinking water, introduced in many cities early in the twentieth century, waterborne diseases such as typhoid, once rife in crowded neighborhoods, might still kill thousands every year.

options.label: Despite the chlorination of drinking water, introduced in many cities early in the twentieth century, waterborne diseases such as typhoid, once rife in crowded neighborhoods, still kill thousands every year.
Waterborne diseases such as typhoid were once common in crowded neighborhoods, and many cities began chlorinating their drinking water soon after 1900.

Had many cities not started chlorinating drinking water in the early 1900s, typhoid and other waterborne diseases, formerly widespread in crowded neighborhoods, might still claim thousands of lives a year.
But for the crowded neighborhoods where typhoid was once rife, many cities might not have begun to treat their water supplies with chlorine early in the twentieth century.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **But for** פירושו ״אלמלא״, כלומר הכלור הוא שמונע את המוות, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך במבנה **Had many cities not started chlorinating** (אילו ערים רבות לא היו מתחילות להוסיף כלור).

_**But for** means without, so chlorination is what prevents the deaths, which the correct answer keeps with **Had many cities not started chlorinating**._

questionText: Original: In one study, the more dishes a menu listed, the less satisfied diners were with whatever they ordered, perhaps because a surfeit of options made it easier to imagine a better choice.

options.label: One study found that the longer the menu, the lower diners' satisfaction with their order, perhaps because an excess of options made it easier to picture a better alternative.
In one study, the more dishes a menu listed, the less satisfied diners were with whatever they ordered, since a surfeit of options made it easier for them to imagine a better choice.
According to one study, diners tended to be less pleased with whatever they ordered from longer menus.
In one study, diners who imagined that another dish would have been a better choice ordered more of the dishes on the menu, perhaps because they were less satisfied.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **perhaps** (אולי) מראה שההסבר הוא השערה בלבד, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת עליה וגם על הקשר **the more ... the less** בצירוף **the longer the menu, the lower** (ככל שהתפריט ארוך יותר, כך נמוכה יותר).

_**perhaps** marks the explanation as a guess, and the correct answer keeps it along with **the more ... the less** as **the longer the menu, the lower**._

questionText: Every Saturday, my grandmother goes to the ________ to buy fresh fruit and vegetables.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הסבתא הולכת לקנות פירות וירקות טריים (**to buy fresh fruit and vegetables**), ולכן התשובה היא **market** (שוק).

_She goes there **to buy fresh fruit and vegetables**, and a **market** is where people buy them._

questionText: The soup was too ________ to eat, so we waited a few minutes for it to cool down.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **so** (לכן) מצביעה על תוצאה: חיכינו שהמרק יתקרר (**for it to cool down**), ולכן הוא היה חם מדי: **hot** (חם).

_The word **so** shows a result: we waited **for it to cool down**, so the soup was too **hot**._

questionText: My shoes are very ________ – there is mud all over them.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** ההסבר שאחרי המקף, **there is mud all over them** (יש עליהן בוץ בכל מקום), מתאר נעליים לא נקיות, ולכן התשובה היא **dirty** (מלוכלך).

_The explanation after the dash, **there is mud all over them**, describes shoes that are **dirty**._

questionText: When the teacher came in, we all stood up and ________ good morning.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** עם הברכה **good morning** (בוקר טוב) משתמשים בפועל **say**, ולכן צורת העבר הנכונה היא **said** (אמרנו).

_We **say** **good morning**, so the correct past form here is **said**._

questionText: The road was icy, so the drivers went very ________ to stay safe.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **so** (לכן) מראה תוצאה של כביש קפוא (**The road was icy**), והמטרה **to stay safe** (להישאר בטוחים) מחייבת זהירות, ולכן הנהגים נסעו **slowly** (לאט).

_The word **so** shows a result of the **icy** road, and **to stay safe** means being careful, so the drivers went **slowly**._

questionText: Our school sells healthy ________, such as apples, carrots and nuts.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **such as** (כמו) מציג דוגמאות: תפוחים, גזר ואגוזים (**apples, carrots and nuts**) הם אוכל קטן ובריא, ולכן התשובה היא **snacks** (נשנושים).

_The examples after **such as**, **apples, carrots and nuts**, are small foods people eat between meals, so the answer is **snacks**._

questionText: If you do not understand the lesson, please raise your hand and ________ a question.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** עם שם העצם **question** (שאלה) באנגלית משתמשים בפועל **ask**, ולכן התשובה היא **ask** (לשאול).

_The noun **question** goes with the verb **ask**, and a student who does not understand wants to ask._

questionText: My aunt is very ________ – she shares her lunch with everyone and gives clothes to people in need.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** ההסבר שאחרי המקף (**shares her lunch with everyone and gives clothes**) מתאר אישה שאוהבת לעזור, ולכן התשובה היא **kind** (טובת לב).

_The explanation after the dash, **shares her lunch with everyone and gives clothes**, describes someone who cares about others, so she is **kind**._

questionText: Although the film had a famous director and a huge budget, most critics found it ________.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Although** (למרות ש) מסמנת ניגוד לבמאי המפורסם ולתקציב הענק (**a famous director and a huge budget**), ולכן המבקרים מצאו את הסרט **dull** (משעמם).

_The word **Although** signals a contrast with **a famous director and a huge budget**, so the critics found the film **dull**._

questionText: Our village is slowly ________: every year more young people leave for the cities, and fewer children are born.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** ההסבר שאחרי הנקודתיים (**more young people leave for the cities, and fewer children are born**) מתאר יישוב שאוכלוסייתו הולכת וקטנה, ולכן התשובה היא **shrinking** (הולך וקטן).

_The explanation after the colon, **more young people leave for the cities, and fewer children are born**, describes a village that is getting smaller, so it is **shrinking**._

questionText: Farmers in this part of the country grow many different kinds of ________, for example wheat, corn and rice.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **for example** (למשל) מציג דוגמאות: חיטה, תירס ואורז (**wheat, corn and rice**) הם צמחים שחקלאים מגדלים, ולכן התשובה היא **crops** (גידולים, יבולים).

_The examples after **for example**, **wheat, corn and rice**, are plants that farmers grow, so the answer is **crops**._

questionText: After years of hard work and saving money, Lina's dream of opening her own shop finally ________ true.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** עם המילה **true** (אמיתי) באנגלית אומרים **come true** (להתגשם), ולכן צורת העבר הנכונה היא **came** (התגשם).

_The phrase **come true** means that a dream becomes real, so the past form here is **came**._

questionText: The instructions were so confusing that many students ________ the question, and they wrote about a different topic.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** התחילית **mis-** פירושה בטעות, ולכן המילה **misread** (קראו לא נכון) מסבירה למה התלמידים כתבו על נושא אחר (**wrote about a different topic**).

_The prefix **mis-** means wrongly, so **misread** explains why the students **wrote about a different topic**._

questionText: Because the problem was serious, the managers called a meeting to ________ it before making any decision.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** בגלל בעיה חמורה (**the problem was serious**) קוראים לפגישה כדי לדון בה, והפועל **discuss** (לדון) בא ישירות לפני הכינוי **it**, ולכן הוא התשובה.

_Because **the problem was serious**, the managers met to **discuss** it, and only **discuss** takes **it** directly._

questionText: Since the restaurant has only a few tables, it is wise to ________ a table early if you want to eat there on Saturday.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Since** (מכיוון ש) מסבירה שיש מעט שולחנות (**only a few tables**), ולכן כדאי להזמין שולחן מראש: **book** (להזמין).

_The word **Since** gives the reason: there are **only a few tables**, so it is wise to **book** one early._

questionText: Although the symptoms of the illness are dramatic in its late stages, its earliest signs are so ________ that even experienced doctors often miss them.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Although** מעמידה את הסימפטומים הדרמטיים של השלב המאוחר (**dramatic in its late stages**) מול הסימנים המוקדמים, שרופאים מנוסים מחמיצים (**often miss them**), ולכן התשובה היא **subtle** (עדין, קשה להבחנה).

_**Although** contrasts the **dramatic** late symptoms with the earliest signs, which doctors **often miss**, so the answer is **subtle** (hard to notice)._

questionText: Fresh-flower sellers may earn a large profit on Monday, but the market is notoriously ________: prices change so quickly that by Friday the same stock may be sold at a loss.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הנקודתיים מסבירים שהמחירים משתנים במהירות (**prices change so quickly**) ועלולים להפוך רווח להפסד, ולכן השוק הוא **erratic** (לא יציב, חסר סדר).

_**But** contrasts Monday's profit with a possible loss, and **prices change so quickly** shows the market is **erratic** (irregular, without a pattern)._

questionText: Although most ancient cities grew up beside rivers, a few developed in ________ places, such as mountain passes, desert oases and tiny offshore islands.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **such as** מביא דוגמאות (**mountain passes, desert oases and tiny offshore islands**), וכולן מקומות רחוקים וקשים להגעה, ולכן התשובה היא **remote** (מרוחק, נידח).

_**Such as** gives examples (**mountain passes, desert oases and tiny offshore islands**), all far from other places, so the answer is **remote** (far away)._

questionText: Although the new bridge was built to ________ congestion in the old town, drivers soon found that their journeys took longer than before.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Although** מעמידה את מטרת הבנייה (**was built to**) מול התוצאה הגרועה (**took longer than before**), ולכן המטרה הייתה **ease** (להקל על, להפחית).

_**Although** contrasts the purpose (**was built to**) with the bad result (**took longer than before**), so the aim was to **ease** (make less severe) the congestion._

questionText: Most people believe that they are better drivers than average; yet this cannot be true for everyone, because people consistently ________ their own skills.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **yet** מראה שהאמונה של רוב האנשים שהם עצמם נהגים טובים מהממוצע (**better drivers than average**) אינה יכולה להיות נכונה לכולם, ולכן התשובה היא **overestimate** (להעריך יתר על המידה).

_**Yet** says the belief in being **better drivers than average** cannot be true for everyone, so people **overestimate** (judge too highly) their skills._

questionText: While several small shops on the main street closed during the recession, the staid old bookshop managed to ________ the storm by cutting costs and selling rare editions online.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **While** מעמידה את החנויות שנסגרו (**closed during the recession**) מול החנות ששרדה, והצירוף הקבוע **weather the storm** פירושו לצלוח תקופה קשה (לשרוד).

_**While** contrasts the shops that **closed during the recession** with one that survived, and the phrase **weather the storm** means to get through hard times._

questionText: Even though the new filter was designed to block every unsuitable website, curious teenagers soon found simple ways to ________ it.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **Even though** מעמיד את מטרת המסנן (**designed to block every unsuitable website**) מול הנערים שמצאו דרכים פשוטות להתחמק ממנו, ולכן התשובה היא **circumvent** (לעקוף).

_**Even though** sets the filter's aim (**designed to block every unsuitable website**) against teenagers who found simple ways to **circumvent** (get around) it._

questionText: The island's famous seabirds appear to thrive; nevertheless, a recent census shows that their numbers are quietly ________: each year, fewer chicks hatch than in the year before.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הנקודתיים מסבירים שבכל שנה בוקעים פחות גוזלים (**fewer chicks hatch than in the year before**), והמילה **nevertheless** מעמידה זאת מול המראה המשגשג, ולכן התשובה היא **diminishing** (הולך וקטן).

_**Nevertheless** contrasts the thriving look with the colon's explanation, **fewer chicks hatch than in the year before**, so the numbers are **diminishing** (getting smaller)._

questionText: Whereas primary-school pupils usually learn best through play, university students tend to prefer ________ teaching, with clear definitions and worked examples.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Whereas** מעמידה למידה דרך משחק (**through play**) מול העדפת הסטודנטים, והפרטים **clear definitions and worked examples** מתארים הוראה **structured** (מובנית, מסודרת).

_**Whereas** contrasts learning **through play** with the students' preference, and **clear definitions and worked examples** describe **structured** (carefully organized) teaching._

questionText: In spite of the council's insistence that its new parking rules are ________, applying the same charges to residents and visitors alike, many shop owners say that the rules harm those who live nearby.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **applying the same charges to residents and visitors alike** מגדיר את החסר: כללים שמתייחסים לכולם באותה צורה הם **equitable** (הוגנים), למרות הטענה של בעלי החנויות.

_The phrase **applying the same charges to residents and visitors alike** defines the blank: rules that treat everyone the same are **equitable** (fair)._

questionText: Although some metals, such as iron and steel, rust easily in damp air, others, such as gold and platinum, are highly ________, which is why they stay bright for thousands of years.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Although** מעמידה מתכות שמחלידות (**rust easily in damp air**) מול הזהב והפלטינה, שנשארים נוצצים (**stay bright for thousands of years**), ולכן הם **unreactive** (שאינם מגיבים בקלות).

_**Although** contrasts metals that **rust easily in damp air** with gold and platinum, which **stay bright for thousands of years** because they are **unreactive** (do not react easily)._

questionText: Although the actor ________ great pains to appear relaxed in interviews, his friends say that he rehearses every answer in advance.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף הקבוע **take great pains to** פירושו להשקיע מאמץ רב כדי שדבר יצליח, וזה מתאים לשחקן שמתאמן על כל תשובה (**rehearses every answer in advance**), ולכן התשובה היא **takes**.

_The fixed phrase **take great pains to** means to make a great effort, which fits an actor who **rehearses every answer in advance**, so the answer is **takes**._

questionText: Although the poem seems at first to be an artless love song, its final stanza gives the whole text a ________ meaning, suggesting that the speaker is in fact mourning a lost childhood.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Although** מעמידה את הקריאה הראשונה (**seems at first to be an artless love song**) מול הבית האחרון, שמגלה התאבלות על ילדות אבודה (**mourning a lost childhood**), ולכן המשמעות היא **profound** (עמוקה).

_**Although** contrasts the simple first reading with the final stanza's **mourning a lost childhood**, so the meaning is **profound** (deep and serious)._

questionText: Because the faint signal had been recorded by a single instrument, the astronomers called their detection of methane on the torrid planet ________, promising a firmer verdict once a second observatory had checked the data.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** אות חלש שנקלט במכשיר אחד בלבד (**recorded by a single instrument**) והבטחה להכרעה מוצקה יותר בהמשך (**promising a firmer verdict**) מראים שהממצא עוד לא סופי, ולכן התשובה היא **tentative** (ראשוני, לא סופי).

_A faint signal **recorded by a single instrument** and **promising a firmer verdict** show the finding is not yet final, so it is **tentative** (provisional)._

questionText: Stripped of tone of voice and facial expression, short text messages are easily ________: a single 'fine' from even the most phlegmatic colleague may read as cold annoyance or as cheerful agreement.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** בלי טון דיבור ובלי הבעת פנים (**Stripped of tone of voice and facial expression**) אותה מילה יכולה להתפרש כרוגז או כהסכמה, ולכן התשובה היא **misconstrued** (מתפרש באופן שגוי).

_**Stripped of tone of voice and facial expression**, one word **may read as cold annoyance or as cheerful agreement**, so messages are **misconstrued** (misunderstood)._

questionText: Whereas the old bus service had been notoriously ________, arriving early one day and forty minutes late the next, the new one keeps so closely to its timetable that commuters set their watches by it.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Whereas** מנגידה את השירות הישן לשירות חדש שמדייק בזמנים, והתיאור **arriving early one day and forty minutes late the next** מראה חוסר סדירות, ולכן התשובה היא **fitful** (לא סדיר, מקוטע).

_**Whereas** contrasts the old service with a punctual one, and **arriving early one day and forty minutes late the next** shows irregularity, so it was **fitful**._

questionText: Even though the pines planted on the parched hillsides were meant to ________ soil erosion, their dense shade killed the grasses whose roots held the soil, and the slopes washed away faster.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילים **Even though** ו**were meant to** מראות שהכוונה הייתה הפוכה לתוצאה, מדרונות שנסחפו מהר יותר (**the slopes washed away faster**), ולכן התשובה היא **mitigate** (למתן, להפחית).

_**Even though** and **were meant to** show the aim was the opposite of the result, **the slopes washed away faster**, so the answer is **mitigate** (reduce)._

questionText: The writing instructor gave every class the same advice: be ________, saying in ten words what others say in fifty, yet never cutting a fact that the reader actually needs.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** לומר בעשר מילים מה שאחרים אומרים בחמישים (**saying in ten words what others say in fifty**) בלי להשמיט עובדה נחוצה פירושו להיות **succinct** (תמציתי).

_**Saying in ten words what others say in fifty** without **cutting a fact that the reader actually needs** means being **succinct** (brief but complete)._

questionText: The engineer never particularly enjoyed studying languages, yet she had a remarkable ________ for them: posted abroad, she could hold simple conversations in each new language within weeks.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **yet** מנגידה את החסר להנאה שלא הייתה, וההסבר **she could hold simple conversations in each new language within weeks** מתאר יכולת, ולכן התשובה היא **aptitude** (כישרון טבעי).

_**Yet** contrasts the blank with enjoyment, and **she could hold simple conversations in each new language within weeks** shows ability, so it is **aptitude** (talent)._

questionText: As any sagacious investor knows, many of a firm's most valuable assets are ________ ones, such as its brand's reputation, its patents and its customers' loyalty, none of which can be stacked in a warehouse.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הדוגמאות **its brand's reputation, its patents and its customers' loyalty** והצירוף **none of which can be stacked in a warehouse** מתארים נכסים בלי צורה פיזית, ולכן התשובה היא **intangible** (בלתי מוחשי).

_The examples, **its brand's reputation, its patents and its customers' loyalty**, cannot **be stacked in a warehouse**, so they are **intangible** (non-physical) assets._

questionText: Some of the most ________ animals, such as the octopus, which uses its sinuous arms to unscrew jars of shrimp, and the crow, which bends wire into hooks, solve problems their ancestors never faced.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הדוגמאות, תמנון שפותח צנצנות ועורב שמכופף חוט לצורת וו, וההמשך **solve problems their ancestors never faced** מתארים כושר המצאה, ולכן התשובה היא **ingenious** (מחוכם, בעל כושר המצאה).

_Unscrewing jars, bending **wire into hooks** and solving **problems their ancestors never faced** show inventiveness, so the animals are **ingenious** (clever and inventive)._

questionText: Many firms pay lip ________ to work-life balance: their glossy brochures extol it at length, yet managers still expect staff to answer emails at midnight.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף הקבוע **pay lip service to** (לתת מס שפתיים) מתאים לשבחים (**extol it at length**) שאין מאחוריהם מעשים (**answer emails at midnight**), ולכן התשובה היא **service**.

_The fixed phrase **pay lip service to** (praise without action) fits brochures that **extol it at length** while managers still expect staff to **answer emails at midnight**._

questionText: Today's placid fishing village, where a few boats drift in at dusk, is a far ________ from the bustling port that, three centuries ago, shipped grain and timber across the Baltic Sea.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף הקבוע **a far cry from** (שונה לגמרי מ...) מתאים לניגוד בין כפר דייגים שקט לבין הנמל ההומה (**the bustling port**) של פעם, ולכן התשובה היא **cry**.

_The fixed phrase **a far cry from** (very different from) fits the contrast between a quiet village and **the bustling port** it once was, so the answer is **cry**._

questionText: Decades in a damp basement caused ________ damage to the letters of a loquacious nineteenth-century composer: the ink faded and the paper crumbled, so that whole pages can never be read again.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** נזק שבגללו דפים שלמים לא ייקראו לעולם (**whole pages can never be read again**) הוא נזק שאי אפשר לתקן, ולכן התשובה היא **irreparable** (**ir-** + **repair** + **-able**: שאין לו תקנה).

_Damage after which **whole pages can never be read again** cannot be repaired, so it is **irreparable** (ir- + repair + -able)._

questionText: With the benefit of ________, many investors insist that they saw the market crash coming, yet remarkably few of these voluble forecasters sold their own shares beforehand.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המשקיעים טוענים רק עכשיו שראו את הקריסה מראש, אבל מעטים מהם מכרו מניות לפני כן (**sold their own shares beforehand**), ולכן התשובה היא **hindsight** (חוכמה בדיעבד).

_They **insist** now that they **saw the market crash coming**, yet few **sold their own shares beforehand**, so this is **hindsight** (wisdom after the event)._

questionText: The success of the vaccination campaign in remote villages ________ on keeping the doses cold: a single afternoon in a stalled, unrefrigerated truck on the serpentine mountain roads could spoil an entire shipment.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הנושא **The success of the vaccination campaign** אינו יכול להתעקש או להרהר, וההסבר שאחרי הנקודתיים מראה תלות מוחלטת בקירור, ולכן התשובה היא **hinged** (**hinge on**: להיות תלוי ב...).

_A **success** cannot insist or dwell, and the colon shows total dependence on cold doses, so the answer is **hinged** (**hinge on** = depend on)._

questionText: After years of quarrels, the two cantankerous founders split their company, and each went back to his ________ field: one to designing batteries, the other to writing software.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **each went back to his** וההסבר **one to designing batteries, the other to writing software** מראים שכל אחד חזר לתחום שלו, ולכן התשובה היא **respective** (של כל אחד בנפרד).

_**Each went back to his** own field, **one to designing batteries, the other to writing software**, so the answer is **respective** (belonging to each one separately)._

questionText: Seldom has so famously ________ a critic written so glowing a review: she called the young novelist's debut the most assured first book she had read in a decade.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Seldom** (לעיתים רחוקות) מראה שביקורת נלהבת כל כך (**so glowing a review**) היא חריגה אצל המבקרת הזאת, ולכן התשובה היא **acerbic** (חריפה ועוקצנית).

_**Seldom** marks a review this **glowing** as unusual for her, so she must be known for biting criticism: **acerbic** (sharply critical)._

questionText: Far from being a late cultural acquisition, a sense of fairness seems ________ in toddlers, who already protest petulantly when a playmate gets more treats, though not yet when they themselves do.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הפעוטות כבר מוחים (**already protest**) כשחבר מקבל יותר, אבל עדיין לא כשהם עצמם מקבלים יותר (**though not yet**), ולכן החוש קיים רק בתחילתו: **incipient** (מתהווה, ראשוני).

_Toddlers **already protest** but **not yet** in every case, so their sense of fairness has begun yet is incomplete: **incipient** (just starting to develop)._

questionText: Wary of buying looted antiquities, museums now scrutinize the ________ of every object they acquire, for example by tracing a statue back through each dealer and collector who has owned it.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הדוגמה מתארת מעקב אחר כל סוחר ואספן שהחזיקו בפסל (**tracing a statue back through each dealer and collector**), ולכן התשובה היא **provenance** (מקור ותולדות הבעלות של חפץ).

_The example, **tracing a statue back through each dealer and collector**, describes an object's ownership history: its **provenance** (origin and chain of owners)._

questionText: Professional reviews of the new phone run the ________ from rapturous to withering, which leaves shoppers, already faced with a bewildering profusion of rival models, little the wiser.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **from rapturous to withering** מתאר טווח שלם מקצה לקצה, והצירוף הקבוע **run the gamut from** פירושו לכסות את כל הקשת, ולכן התשובה היא **gamut** (כל הטווח, מכלול).

_The range **from rapturous to withering** calls for the fixed phrase **run the gamut**, meaning to cover every point between two extremes: **gamut**._

questionText: Her years as a waitress in a busy diner stood her in good ________ when she later took over a down-at-heel hotel and had to keep both guests and staff content.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילים **stood her in good** פותחות את הצירוף הקבוע **stand someone in good stead** (להועיל למישהו בהמשך הדרך), ולכן התשובה היא **stead**.

_The words **stood her in good** begin the fixed phrase **stand someone in good stead**, meaning to prove useful later: **stead**._

questionText: Rather than state plainly that the pilot program had failed, the agency's report resorted to ________, spending three long paragraphs edging around a fact that four words could have conveyed.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הדוח השתמש בשלוש פסקאות ארוכות כדי לעקוף עובדה (**edging around a fact**) במקום לומר אותה ישירות (**state plainly**), ולכן התשובה היא **circumlocution** (דיבור עקיף ומסורבל, 'סחור סחור').

_Instead of saying it **plainly**, the report spent **three long paragraphs edging around a fact**, which is **circumlocution** (roundabout, wordy speech)._

questionText: She received the university's acceptance letter and, a week later, its rejection of her scholarship application with the same ________, neither celebrating the one nor lamenting the other.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילים **neither celebrating the one nor lamenting the other** מתארות רוח שקולה זהה מול בשורה טובה ובשורה רעה, ולכן התשובה היא **equanimity** (שלוות נפש, יישוב דעת).

_The phrase **neither celebrating the one nor lamenting the other** describes the same calm mind in good and bad news alike: **equanimity** (calm composure)._

questionText: Rather than reject the union's increasingly strident demands outright, management chose to ________, promising a review here and a working group there in the hope that the issue would quietly fade.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** ההנהלה פיזרה הבטחות כדי שהעניין ייעלם מעצמו (**in the hope that the issue would quietly fade**), כלומר משכה זמן בכוונה, ולכן התשובה היא **temporize** (להרוויח זמן, לדחות הכרעה).

_Management made vague promises **in the hope that the issue would quietly fade**, deliberately stalling: **temporize** (delay to gain time)._

questionText: Although the mountain stream looks perfectly clear, its water is far from ________: laboratory tests routinely find parasites that can cause severe stomach illness in hikers who drink it untreated.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המים נראים צלולים, אבל בבדיקות מוצאים בהם טפילים שגורמים למחלה אצל מי ששותה אותם (**hikers who drink it untreated**), ולכן התשובה היא **potable** (ראוי לשתייה).

_Tests find parasites that sicken **hikers who drink it untreated**, so the clear-looking water is unsafe to drink: far from **potable** (drinkable)._

questionText: Before astronomers could predict their orbits, comets were widely regarded as ________ omens: their sudden appearance was taken to foretell floods, failed harvests or the fall of rulers.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** לפי ההסבר שאחרי הנקודתיים, הופעת השביטים נחשבה לסימן לשיטפונות, ליבול כושל ולנפילת שליטים (**to foretell floods, failed harvests or the fall of rulers**), ולכן התשובה היא **baleful** (מבשר רעות, מאיים).

_Comets were thought **to foretell floods, failed harvests or the fall of rulers**, so they were threatening signs: **baleful** (menacing, harmful)._

questionText: Instead of hosting the genteel debate their founders imagined, many online comment sections turn ________ within a dozen replies, as polite disagreement over a recipe gives way to personal insults.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** אי-הסכמה מנומסת הופכת לעלבונות אישיים (**gives way to personal insults**), כלומר הטון נעשה ארסי ועוין, ולכן התשובה היא **vitriolic** (ארסי, מלא שנאה).

_Polite disagreement **gives way to personal insults**, so the comments turn bitterly hostile: **vitriolic** (full of venom)._

questionText: Some invasive plants owe their conquest of riverbanks less to hardiness than to sheer ________: a single nondescript weed, for example, can shed tens of thousands of seeds in a season.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הדוגמה מתארת עשב אחד שמפיל עשרות אלפי זרעים בעונה (**can shed tens of thousands of seeds in a season**), ולכן סוד ההצלחה הוא ריבוי עצום, והתשובה היא **fecundity** (פוריות).

_The example, a weed that **can shed tens of thousands of seeds in a season**, shows sheer reproductive power: **fecundity** (fertility)._

questionText: Critics dismissed the newly created post of heritage adviser as a ________: it carried a generous salary and ample perquisites, yet demanded little beyond the occasional ribbon-cutting.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המשרה מעניקה משכורת נדיבה והטבות (**a generous salary and ample perquisites**) אך כמעט אינה דורשת עבודה (**demanded little**), ולכן התשובה היא **sinecure** (משרה נוחה ומכניסה בלי עבודה של ממש).

_The post offers **a generous salary and ample perquisites** yet **demanded little**, so it is a **sinecure** (a well-paid job with almost no work)._

questionText: Although the octogenarian diplomat's memoir is riddled with errors of date and name, it would be unfair to call it ________: its author never invents an episode but merely misremembers a few.
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המחבר אינו ממציא אף אירוע אלא רק טועה בזיכרונו (**never invents an episode but merely misremembers a few**), ולכן אי אפשר להאשים אותו בשקר, והתשובה היא **mendacious** (שקרי, כוזב במכוון).

_The author **never invents an episode but merely misremembers a few**, so the memoir is mistaken, not lying, and it is unfair to call it **mendacious** (deliberately untruthful)._

questionText: What is the main purpose of the passage?

options.label: To warn readers not to keep bread in the refrigerator
To show that bread goes stale mainly because its water slowly escapes into the air around it
To explain the real cause of staling and how temperature and heat affect it
To describe the many ways in which foods change as they grow older

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המשפט **The main cause of staling lies in starch** (הסיבה העיקרית להתיישנות היא העמילן) ופסקאות 3–4 על קור וחום מראים שהמטרה היא להסביר מה באמת גורם ללחם להתיישן.

_The sentence **The main cause of staling lies in starch** and the paragraphs on cold and heat show that the passage explains what really makes bread stale._

questionText: According to paragraph 2, why does bread in a sealed plastic bag still go stale?

options.label: Water escapes slowly through the bag into the air.
Its starch grains swell and grow soft as the bread cools.
Its starch grains were not loosened enough during baking.
Its starch hardens although the bread keeps its water.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** בפסקה 2 נאמר שהעמילן מתקשה גם כשלא אובדים מים (הצירוף **even when no water is lost**), ולכן גם לחם בשקית סגורה מתיישן.

_Paragraph 2 says the starch hardens **even when no water is lost**, so a sealed bag cannot stop staling._

questionText: According to paragraph 3, why does bread go stale faster in a refrigerator than at room temperature?

options.label: The cold, dry air inside a refrigerator slowly draws the water out of the bread.
Its starch hardens most quickly in cold conditions above freezing.
The water inside the loaf turns to ice.
Bread at room temperature is usually eaten sooner.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **so** בפסקה 3 מחברת סיבה לתוצאה: העמילן מתקשה הכי מהר כשהוא קר אבל לא קפוא (הצירוף **cool but not frozen**), ולכן לחם במקרר מתיישן מהר יותר.

_The word **so** links cause and effect: starch hardens fastest when it is **cool but not frozen**, and a refrigerator keeps bread exactly that way._

questionText: The word "reversed" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** אחרי המילה **reversed** בא ההסבר **the bread becomes soft once more** (הלחם נעשה רך שוב), ולכן המשמעות היא בוטל, הוחזר לקדמותו (**undone**).

_The next sentence, **the bread becomes soft once more**, shows that **reversed** means undone._

questionText: What can be inferred from paragraph 4 about heating stale bread?

options.label: It keeps the bread soft for several days afterward.
It puts back the water that the bread lost while it was stored.
It may be the best way to store bread for a long time.
It is most useful just before the bread is going to be eaten.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** לפי פסקה 4 הרכות לא נשמרת (המשפט **The effect does not last**) והלחם מתקשה כשהוא מתקרר (הצירוף **As soon as the bread cools**), ולכן כדאי לחמם אותו רק רגע לפני האכילה.

_Since **The effect does not last** and the bread hardens **As soon as the bread cools**, heating helps most right before eating._

questionText: Which of the following best expresses the main idea of the passage?

options.label: A trade that critics called foolish soon collapsed, since most of its ice melted long before it arrived.
A trade that many expected to fail did well for decades until machines took its place.
Sawdust and tightly packed blocks made it possible to ship ice over long distances.
Keeping food cold has been a problem for people in many places and periods.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הקטע עובר מהלעג לתוכנית (הצירוף **derided the scheme as foolish**), דרך הצמיחה של הסחר (הצירוף **the trade grew rapidly**) ועד הדעיכה שלו (המשפט **The trade did not last**), והתשובה הנכונה מכסה את שלושת השלבים.

_The passage moves from doubt (**derided the scheme as foolish**) to success (**the trade grew rapidly**) to decline (**The trade did not last**)._

questionText: According to the passage, why did the traders pack the blocks of ice tightly together?

options.label: It left room on board for the sawdust that kept out the heat.
Ships sailing south had very little space for cargo.
Ice in one large mass melts more slowly than ice in loose pieces.
Tightly packed blocks were probably easier to unload at warm ports.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** בפסקה 2 המילה **since** (מכיוון ש-) מציגה את הסיבה: גוש קרח מוצק נמס לאט יותר מחתיכות נפרדות (הצירוף **a solid mass of ice melts more slowly than separate pieces**).

_The word **since** gives the reason: **a solid mass of ice melts more slowly than separate pieces**._

questionText: According to the passage, which of the following did a steady supply of ice allow at home?

options.label: Moving fresh meat and fish over longer distances
Cooling people's houses during the hottest summer weeks
Freezing water into ice in local factories
Keeping food cold without the need for iceboxes

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** בפסקה 3 נאמר שאספקה קבועה אפשרה לבשר ולדגים טריים לנסוע רחוק יותר (הצירוף **let fresh meat and fish travel farther**), כלומר להוביל אותם למרחקים ארוכים יותר.

_Paragraph 3 says the steady supply **let fresh meat and fish travel farther**, so they could be moved over longer distances._

questionText: The word "rates" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המשפט עוסק בעלות (הצירוף **cost less than one might expect**), ולכן הצירוף **low rates** פירושו תשלום נמוך: **prices** (מחירים, תעריפים).

_The sentence is about cost (**cost less than one might expect**), so **rates** here means prices._

questionText: It can be inferred from the passage that before ice-making machines spread,

options.label: buyers probably trusted lake ice more, since it seemed cleaner than factory ice
a warm winter could leave too little ice for the following summer
most families already kept their food cold with electric refrigerators
a mild winter could not reduce the summer supply of ice

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **no longer meant a summer shortage** (כבר לא גרם למחסור בקיץ) מלמד שלפני המכונות חורף מתון אכן גרם למחסור בקרח בקיץ שאחריו.

_**no longer meant a summer shortage** implies that before the machines, a mild winter did cause a shortage of ice._

questionText: Which of the following best expresses the main idea of the passage?

options.label: Orchestral music generally needs longer reverberation than speech does.
Since about 1900, designers have been able to build halls that suit both speech and orchestral music equally well, even when the halls are large.
The design of a building can influence how people experience what happens inside it.
A hall's sound depends on its reverberation, which is shaped by materials and form and should suit the hall's use.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** ההדהוד קובע במידה רבה איך חדר נשמע (הצירוף **largely determines how a room sounds**), ושאר הקטע מראה שההדהוד תלוי בייעוד האולם, בחומרים ובצורה (המשפט **Shape matters as well**).

_Reverberation **largely determines how a room sounds**, and the rest of the passage links it to purpose, materials and shape (**Shape matters as well**)._

questionText: What does the passage say about the design of halls before about 1900?

options.label: Builders could already predict reverberation well, but most of them still preferred to copy older halls.
Without a dependable way to predict reverberation, builders imitated halls that people admired.
Most halls built in that period probably sounded better than later ones.
Builders copied admired halls, and the results were usually excellent.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המבנה **not until about 1900 did designers have a reliable method** (רק בסביבות 1900 הייתה שיטה אמינה) והצירוף **relied on copying admired older halls** מראים שקודם לכן העתיקו אולמות בלי יכולת לחזות.

_**not until about 1900 did designers have a reliable method**, so before then builders **relied on copying admired older halls**._

questionText: According to the passage, why does speech call for a short reverberation time?

options.label: A short reverberation gives the speaker's voice the warmth that listeners enjoy.
Speech, like orchestral music, depends on successive sounds blending into one another.
Otherwise one syllable would still be heard when the next one began.
Words spoken in a large room usually lose much of their sound to curtains and carpets.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **since** (מכיוון ש-) מביאה את הסיבה: כל הברה צריכה לדעוך לפני שהבאה מגיעה (הצירוף **each syllable must fade before the next one arrives**), אחרת הברה אחת עדיין נשמעת כשהבאה מתחילה.

_The word **since** gives the reason: **each syllable must fade before the next one arrives**, or **the sounds overlap**._

questionText: As used in the passage, the word "pronounced" is closest in meaning to
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **As a result** מציג את ההבדל בין אולם ריק למלא כתוצאה של הבליעה החזקה של הקהל, ולכן המילה **pronounced** פירושה בולט וניכר (**clearly noticeable**).

_After **As a result**, the audience's strong absorption makes the empty-versus-full difference **pronounced**, that is, clearly noticeable._

questionText: It can be inferred from the passage that shoebox halls

options.label: usually seat fewer listeners than wider halls do
lose many of the side reflections that listeners value
were probably built before designers could predict reverberation
usually absorb more sound than wider halls because of their padded seats

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **Wider halls, which can seat more people** (אולמות רחבים יותר, שאפשר להושיב בהם יותר אנשים) מלמד שאולמות קופסת הנעליים, הצרים, מושיבים בדרך כלל פחות מאזינים.

_The passage contrasts narrow shoeboxes with **Wider halls, which can seat more people**, so shoeboxes usually seat fewer listeners._

questionText: Which of the following best expresses the main idea of the passage?

options.label: Whistled speech carries ordinary languages across rough terrain, but its future is now uncertain.
Whistlers of tonal languages copy the melody of tones, while others imitate shifts from vowel to vowel.
Whistled speech, once a practical tool in remote areas, has been successfully restored to daily use through school teaching.
Whistled speech, an ordinary language carried by whistles, is now kept alive mainly by older speakers.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הקטע מסביר מהי השריקה (הצירוף **an ordinary spoken language transposed into whistles**), למה היא נוצרה ואיך היא עובדת, ומסיים בעתיד פתוח (הצירוף **remains to be seen**).

_The passage explains what whistled speech is (**an ordinary spoken language transposed into whistles**) and why it arose, then ends on an open future: **remains to be seen**._

questionText: According to the passage, whistled speech

options.label: is a limited set of signals, much like those used to call animals
can be understood by listeners who do not speak the underlying language
conveys an existing spoken language rather than a system of its own
can express more than the spoken language it is based on

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המבנה **Far from being a mere set of signals** (רחוק מלהיות אוסף אותות) והצירוף **an ordinary spoken language transposed into whistles** מראים שהשריקה מעבירה שפה מדוברת קיימת.

_**Far from being a mere set of signals**, whistled speech is **an ordinary spoken language transposed into whistles**._

questionText: According to the passage, in whistled forms of languages without tones, consonants

options.label: carry the melody that tells one word from another
are whistled more loudly than vowels so that they carry farther
can usually be identified on their own, without help from context
are heard as short pauses or glides between vowel sounds

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** לפי פסקה 3, בשפות שאין בהן טונים העיצורים מושמעים כהפסקות קצרות או כהחלקות (הצירוף **rendering consonants as brief breaks or slides**), כלומר הם נשמעים בין צלילי התנועות.

_In languages without tones, whistlers imitate vowel shifts, **rendering consonants as brief breaks or slides**._

questionText: As used in the passage, the word "outstrip" is closest in meaning to
explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **a skill in which** (מיומנות שבה) מציג השוואה של מיומנות, ולכן המילה **outstrip** פירושה לעלות על, להצטיין יותר מ- (**surpass**).

_**a skill in which** signals a comparison of ability, so those raised with whistling **outstrip**, or surpass, adult learners._

questionText: Which of the following does the passage suggest about teaching whistled speech in schools?

options.label: It might preserve whistling as a mark of identity rather than as a practical tool.
It has already restored whistling to the daily role it once played.
It is bound to prove unavailing, since mobile phones have removed the need for whistling.
It might make whistling more widely used than it was before roads and phones arrived.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המשפט האחרון שואל אם ההוראה תחזיר שימוש יומיומי או רק תשמור את השריקה כסמל (הצירוף **a cherished emblem of local identity**), ולכן ייתכן שהיא תישמר כסמל ולא ככלי.

_The last sentence weighs daily use against **a cherished emblem of local identity**, so schools might keep whistling as a symbol, not a tool._

questionText: Original: The bakery on our street is open every day except Sunday.

options.label: Our street's bakery is closed on Sunday but open on every other day.
Our street's bakery opens from Monday to Friday, and on Saturday and Sunday it stays closed.
The bakery on our street is closed every day except Sunday.
The bakery on our street is open every day.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **except** (חוץ מ-) קובעת שהמאפייה פתוחה בכל יום מלבד יום ראשון, והתשובה הנכונה אומרת זאת בעזרת הצירוף **closed on Sunday** (סגורה ביום ראשון) והצירוף **open on every other day** (פתוחה בכל יום אחר).

_**Except Sunday** means closed on Sunday and open on all the other days, and the correct answer says exactly that with **closed on Sunday** and **open on every other day**._

questionText: Original: Lena's grandfather taught her to play chess in the park.

options.label: Lena's grandfather played chess with her in the park.
Lena's grandfather taught her to play chess in the park so that she could beat her brother.
Lena taught her grandfather to play chess in the park.
Lena learned to play chess in the park from her grandfather.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **Lena's grandfather taught her** (סבא של לנה לימד אותה) קובע שהסבא הוא המורה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על התפקידים בעזרת הצירוף **learned ... from her grandfather** (למדה מסבא שלה).

_**Lena's grandfather taught her** makes the grandfather the teacher, and the correct answer keeps the roles with **learned ... from her grandfather**._

questionText: Original: Some children in the school band can read music, but most of them cannot.

options.label: Some children in the school band can read music, but most of them cannot sing.
In the school band, a few children can read music, while most cannot.
Most of the children in the school band can read music, but some of them cannot.
Some children in the school band can read music.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המשפט המקורי מפריד בין החלק שיודע לקרוא תווים (**Some**, חלק) לבין הרוב שאינו יודע (**most of them cannot**), והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בעזרת הצירוף **a few** והצירוף **most cannot**.

_**Some children ... can read music** and **most of them cannot** are two parts, and the correct answer keeps both with **a few children can** and **most cannot**._

questionText: Original: Jan was tired after the trip, but he finished his homework before dinner.

options.label: Jan was exhausted after the trip, but he still finished his homework before dinner.
Jan finished his homework after dinner, although he was tired from the trip.
Jan felt tired after the trip, yet he got his homework done before dinner.
Jan was tired after the trip because he finished his homework before dinner.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **but** (אבל) מעמידה את העייפות מול סיום שיעורי הבית, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם ועל הזמן בעזרת הצירוף **got his homework done** (סיים את שיעורי הבית) והצירוף **before dinner** (לפני ארוחת הערב).

_**But** sets the tiredness against finishing the homework, and the correct answer keeps both and the time with **got his homework done** and **before dinner**._

questionText: Original: When a river floods in spring, it carries rich soil onto the nearby fields, so farmers in the valley often harvest more crops that year.

options.label: The year after a spring flood, farmers in the valley often harvest more crops, because the soil that the river carries onto the nearby fields is richer.
A river that floods in spring carries rich soil onto the nearby fields.
When farmers in the valley harvest more crops, the river floods in spring and carries rich soil onto the nearby fields.
In years when the river overflows in spring and leaves rich soil on neighboring fields, farmers in the valley often get larger harvests.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **so** (ולכן) מראה שההצפה באביב היא הסיבה ושהיבול הגדול של החקלאים הוא התוצאה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על הכיוון הזה ועל הצירוף **that year** (באותה שנה) בעזרת הצירוף **In years when** (בשנים שבהן).

_**So** makes the spring flood the cause and the farmers' bigger harvest the result, and the correct answer keeps this direction and **that year** with **In years when**._

questionText: Original: The company will not hire any new workers until its sales have grown for three months in a row.

options.label: New workers will be hired only when the company's sales have more than doubled over three months.
The company will take on new workers only after its sales have risen for three months in a row.
After three months of growing sales, the company will stop hiring new workers.
Although its sales have grown for three months in a row, the company will not hire any new workers.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **will not hire ... until** (לא תגייס עד ש-) קובע שהחברה תגייס עובדים רק אחרי שלושה חודשים של גידול במכירות, והתשובה הנכונה אומרת זאת בעזרת הצירוף **only after** (רק אחרי).

_**Will not hire ... until** means that hiring starts only after three months of growth, and the correct answer says this with **only after**._

questionText: Original: Not all of the students who begin the online course finish it, but those who do usually pass the final exam.

options.label: Most students drop out of the online course before the end, but those who finish it usually pass the final exam.
Students who pass the final exam usually finish the online course, but not all of them begin it.
Some students quit the online course early, yet those who stay to the end usually pass the final exam.
Some students who begin the online course do not finish it.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **Not all of the students** (לא כולם) פירושו שחלקם אינם מסיימים, והתשובה הנכונה אומרת זאת בעזרת המילה **Some** והפועל **quit** (פרשו) ושומרת על הצירוף **usually pass the final exam**.

_**Not all of the students** means that some do not finish, and the correct answer says this with **Some ... quit** and keeps **usually pass the final exam**._

questionText: Original: Despite the heavy rain that fell throughout the night, the marathon began on time because the organizers had prepared for bad weather.

options.label: The marathon started on time in spite of heavy rain all night because the organizers had prepared for bad weather.
Although the organizers had prepared for bad weather, the heavy rain that fell throughout the night delayed the marathon.
The marathon began on time even though it rained throughout the night, thanks to the extra staff that the organizers had hired to prepare for bad weather.
Because of the heavy rain that fell throughout the night, the organizers prepared for inclement weather and the marathon began on time.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Despite** (למרות) מראה שהגשם לא מנע את תחילת המרתון בזמן, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על הניגוד ועל הסיבה בעזרת הצירוף **in spite of** (למרות) והמילה **because** (מפני ש-).

_**Despite** shows that the rain did not stop the marathon from starting on time, and the correct answer keeps the contrast and the reason with **in spite of** and **because**._

questionText: Original: Although the new tram line has shortened the daily journey to work for many residents, a survey found that it has also made their neighborhood noticeably noisier.

options.label: The new tram line has saved thousands of residents hours of travel time, but a survey found that it has also made their neighborhood unbearably noisy.
Many residents now reach work faster thanks to the new tram line, yet, according to a survey, it has also made their neighborhood noticeably noisier.
Although the new tram line has made their neighborhood noticeably noisier, a survey found that it has also lengthened the daily journey to work for many residents.
A survey found that the new tram line has shortened the daily journey to work for many residents.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המילה **Although** (אף על פי ש-) מציבה את קיצור הנסיעה מול הרעש, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שני הצדדים בעזרת הצירוף **reach work faster** (מגיעים לעבודה מהר יותר) והצירוף **has also made ... noisier**.

_**Although** sets the shorter journey to work against the noise, and the correct answer keeps both sides with **reach work faster** and **has also made ... noisier**._

questionText: Original: A small study of office workers suggests that keeping a plant on the desk may slightly reduce stress, although the effect was seen only in people who already felt anxious.

options.label: In a study of office workers, those who kept a plant on the desk became less anxious because the plant slightly improved the air in the office.
A small study suggests that office workers who feel stressed may be slightly more likely to keep a plant on the desk, although this was seen only in people who already felt anxious.
A small study of office workers showed clearly that keeping a plant on the desk greatly reduces stress, even in people who did not feel anxious.
Findings from a small study of office workers hint that a desk plant may slightly lessen stress, but only for people who were already anxious.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **may slightly reduce stress** (אולי מפחית מעט לחץ) והמילה **only** (רק) מגבילים את הטענה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בעזרת הצירוף **may slightly lessen** והצירוף **only for people who were already anxious**.

_**May slightly reduce stress** and **only** limit the claim, and the correct answer keeps both limits with **may slightly lessen** and **only for people who were already anxious**._

questionText: Original: The physicist who was awarded the prize had been trained by the engineer whom she later criticized in print.

options.label: The engineer won the prize after training the physicist, who later criticized him publicly.
Trained by the physicist, the engineer was later awarded the prize and criticized her in print.
The engineer who had trained the prizewinning physicist was later criticized by her in print.
Before she was trained by the engineer, the physicist who was awarded the prize had criticized him in print.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **had been trained by the engineer** (הוכשרה על ידי המהנדס) קובע שהמהנדס הוא המאמן, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך בעזרת הצירוף **had trained** (אימן) והצירוף **was later criticized by her** (ספג ממנה ביקורת).

_**Had been trained by the engineer** makes the engineer the trainer, and the correct answer keeps the roles with **had trained the ... physicist** and **was later criticized by her**._

questionText: Original: Only a minority of the firms that tried a four-day week reverted to their old schedules once the trial ended, and scarcely any of them reported a drop in output.

options.label: Most of the firms that tried a four-day week did not go back to their former hours after the trial, and almost none said their output had fallen.
Most of the firms that tried a four-day week reverted to their old schedules once the trial ended, and scarcely any of them reported a drop in output.
Scarcely any of the firms that tried a four-day week found their staff lackadaisical, so only a minority of them reverted to their old schedules when it ended.
Most of the firms that tried a four-day week stayed with it after the trial, mainly because so few of them saw any drop in output.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **Only a minority** פירושו שרוב החברות לא חזרו, והצירוף **scarcely any** פירושו כמעט אף אחת, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בצירופים **Most ... did not go back** (רובן לא חזרו) ו-**almost none** (כמעט אף אחת).

_**Only a minority** reverted, so most did not, and **scarcely any** means almost none, so the correct answer keeps both with **Most ... did not go back** and **almost none**._

questionText: Original: For all the panoply of modern engineering, some harbor walls that the Romans built with volcanic ash have outlasted concrete structures poured less than a century ago.

options.label: Thanks to the panoply of modern engineering, some harbor walls that the Romans built with volcanic ash have outlasted concrete structures poured less than a century ago.
Although modern engineering offers an impressive range of methods, certain Roman harbor walls made with volcanic ash have lasted longer than concrete poured within the past century.
Some harbor walls that the Romans built with volcanic ash have proved more durable than certain concrete structures poured within the last hundred years.
Modern engineers have been pouring concrete mixed with volcanic ash for less than a century, and yet some of their harbor walls have already outlasted the ones that the ancient Romans built.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **For all** פירושו כאן 'למרות', כלומר החומות הרומיות החזיקו מעמד יותר מבטון חדש אף על פי שההנדסה התקדמה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על הוויתור במילה **Although** (אף על פי ש-).

_**For all** means despite here, so the Roman walls outlasted newer concrete even though engineering has advanced, and the correct answer keeps this with **Although**._

questionText: Original: The ballad, which a folklorist transcribed in the 1930s from the singing of an itinerant peddler, is now taught in schools by teachers who have never heard it sung.

options.label: In the 1930s an itinerant peddler transcribed the ballad from the singing of a folklorist, and it is now taught in schools by teachers who have never heard it sung.
Teachers in the 1930s taught the ballad in schools without having heard it sung, and a folklorist is only now writing it down as an itinerant peddler sings it.
The ballad that teachers now sing in schools was transcribed in the 1930s by a folklorist who had never heard a wandering peddler perform it.
A folklorist wrote the ballad down in the 1930s after hearing a traveling peddler sing it, and schoolteachers who have never heard it performed now teach it.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **from the singing of an itinerant peddler** אומר שחוקר הפולקלור רשם את מה שהרוכל שר, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על התפקידים ועל הזמנים בצירופים **after hearing** (אחרי ששמע) ו-**now teach** (מלמדים היום).

_**From the singing of an itinerant peddler** means the folklorist wrote down the peddler's song, and the correct answer keeps these roles and times._

questionText: Original: Because caffeine blocks a chemical signal of tiredness that builds up in the brain during waking hours, coffee can keep somnolence at bay for hours without reducing the body's need for rest.

options.label: By blocking a chemical signal of tiredness that builds up in the brain during waking hours, caffeine lets coffee drinkers stay alert for several hours at a stretch.
Coffee can keep somnolence at bay for hours without reducing the body's need for rest, since caffeine blocks a chemical signal of tiredness that builds up in the brain during sleep.
Caffeine blocks a chemical sign of fatigue that accumulates in the brain while we are awake, so coffee can ward off sleepiness for hours, yet the body needs just as much rest.
Caffeine is itself a chemical signal of tiredness that builds up in the brain during waking hours, so drinking too much coffee can keep the body from getting the rest it needs.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** לפי הצירוף **during waking hours** האות מצטבר בזמן שהאדם ער, והקפה אינו מקטין את הצורך במנוחה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך בצירוף **yet the body needs just as much rest** (ובכל זאת הגוף צריך אותה כמות מנוחה).

_The signal builds up **during waking hours** and coffee works **without reducing the body's need for rest**, and the correct answer keeps both._

questionText: Original: Despite its name, the Silk Road, a web of routes linking China with the Mediterranean, carried a plethora of goods besides silk, and few merchants ever traveled its entire length.

options.label: Named after the silk that made its merchants rich, the web of routes linking China with the Mediterranean carried many other goods as well, and few traders ever traveled its entire length.
Whatever its name suggests, the routes linking China with the Mediterranean known as the Silk Road carried a plethora of goods besides silk, and a good many merchants traveled them from end to end.
Few of the merchants who carried silk along the network of routes linking China with the Mediterranean ever learned how the Silk Road got its name.
Only a handful of merchants ever covered the full length of the Silk Road, a network of routes between China and the Mediterranean that, its name notwithstanding, carried many goods besides silk.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **Despite its name** אומר שהדרך נשאה הרבה מלבד משי, והמילה **few** אומרת שמעטים עברו את כל אורכה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בצירופים **its name notwithstanding** (למרות שמה) ו-**Only a handful** (רק קומץ).

_**Despite its name** and **few merchants** must both survive, and the correct answer keeps them with **its name notwithstanding** and **Only a handful**._

questionText: Original: Once all but extinct in the wild, the antelope now roams several reserves, though not every herd released into them has survived without the rangers' ministrations.

options.label: Once all but extinct in the wild, the antelope now roams several reserves, and every herd released into them has survived without the rangers' ministrations.
The antelope, which had nearly vanished from the wild, now lives in several reserves, though some of the herds set free there have been unable to survive without rangers' care.
Having almost died out in the wild, the antelope can now be found in several reserves, but most of the herds released into them have had to rely on the rangers to keep them alive.
Herds of the antelope roamed several reserves until all but a few of them died out, so rangers now care for every herd that is released into the wild.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **all but extinct** פירושו כמעט נכחד, והצירוף **not every herd** פירושו שחלק מהעדרים לא שרדו בלי עזרה, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בצירופים **nearly vanished** ו-**some of the herds**.

_**All but extinct** means almost extinct, and **not every herd** means some herds needed help; the correct answer keeps both with **nearly vanished** and **some of the herds**._

questionText: Original: Were it not for the heat trapped by gases such as water vapor and carbon dioxide, the average temperature at Earth's surface would be well below freezing, a climate inimical to most life.

options.label: The heat that gases such as water vapor and carbon dioxide trap is what keeps the average temperature at Earth's surface well below freezing, a climate inimical to most life.

If Earth's atmosphere lacked water vapor, carbon dioxide and the other gases that trap heat, its surface would freeze solid from the poles to the equator, and hardly any form of life could survive there.
Gases like water vapor and carbon dioxide trap heat, and without that heat Earth's average surface temperature would drop far below freezing, producing conditions hostile to most life.
Gases such as water vapor and carbon dioxide trap so much heat that the average temperature at Earth's surface stays well above freezing, a climate inimical to most life.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** המבנה **Were it not for** פירושו 'אלמלא', כלומר בלי החום שהגזים לוכדים הטמפרטורה הייתה נמוכה בהרבה מנקודת הקיפאון, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך בצירוף **without that heat** (בלי החום הזה).

_**Were it not for** means without, so the trapped heat keeps Earth from being well below freezing, and the correct answer keeps this with **without that heat**._

questionText: Original: Much to the chagrin of the professional astronomers who had predicted its return, the comet was first spotted not by any of them but by an amateur with a homemade telescope.

options.label: An amateur with a homemade telescope sighted the comet before any of the professional astronomers who had forecast its return did, and this greatly annoyed them.
Much to the chagrin of an amateur with a homemade telescope, the comet whose return he had predicted was first spotted by professional astronomers.
The comet was spotted by an amateur with a homemade telescope before the professional astronomers had even predicted its return, which left them deeply embarrassed.
The professional astronomers who had predicted the comet's return were chagrined to learn that an amateur had built a better homemade telescope than any of theirs.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **not by any of them but by an amateur** אומר שהחובב ראה את השביט לפני המקצוענים שחזו את חזרתו, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על כך בצירוף **before any of the professional astronomers** (לפני כל אחד מהמקצוענים).

_**Not by any of them but by an amateur** means the amateur saw the comet before the professionals who predicted it, and the correct answer keeps these roles._

questionText: Original: No article in an openly edited online encyclopedia is safe from vandalism, but errors on its most-viewed pages are, as a rule, expunged within minutes, whereas those on obscure pages may linger for months.

options.label: Although any article in an openly edited online encyclopedia can be vandalized, errors on most of its pages are usually corrected within minutes, whereas those on obscure pages may linger for months.

Vandalism can strike any of the articles in an openly edited online encyclopedia, and although errors on its most-viewed pages are quickly expunged, its obscure pages are riddled with mistakes that linger for months on end.
Vandals who target the most-viewed pages of an openly edited online encyclopedia are, as a rule, caught within minutes, whereas those who target obscure pages may go unnoticed for months.

Any article in a freely editable online encyclopedia may be vandalized; still, mistakes on the pages people read most are usually removed within minutes, while those on little-known pages can stay for months.

explanation:
**הסבר קצר:** הצירוף **its most-viewed pages** מגביל את התיקון המהיר לדפים הנצפים ביותר והמילה **may** מסייגת, והתשובה הנכונה שומרת על שניהם בצירופים **the pages people read most** ו-**can stay** (עלולות להישאר).

_**Its most-viewed pages** limits the quick fixes and **may** hedges the delay, and the correct answer keeps both with **the pages people read most** and **can stay**._
